issues.description: Fields numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents have inconsistent types between the problem statement UML and the reference solution. The UML in problem_statement.md declares: numberOfInscribedStudents: double and numberOfGuestStudents: double (lines 65-66). The reference implementation in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java declares these fields as int (lines 7-8) and the class exposes getTotalNumberOfStudents() with an int return (problem statement UML line 70 and solution method return type). This mismatch is likely to confuse students about whether to implement these attributes and related methods using double or int and which return types to use.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the student-count types consistent across artifacts. Recommended: update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as int to match the reference solution and the int return type of getTotalNumberOfStudents. Alternatively, if fractional student counts are intended, change the reference implementation (and any method return types/descriptions such as getTotalNumberOfStudents) to use double consistently and update the UML and textual descriptions accordingly.
